items.label: WHAT'S INCLUDED
items.value: All you need is the ball and an app subscription—no additional hardware needed! (Note: Mobile device not included; compatible with Apple iOS & Android devices.)

items.label: PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS
items.value: Access the same advanced analytics used by top players and coaches to elevate your game. Warranty Support — If you experience any issues, message us through your Amazon order and we’ll provide a free replacement or refund under warranty.

items.label: ADVANCED SHOT TRACKING
items.value: Our app and basketball precisely track makes, misses, swishes, shot locations, and more.

items.label: INSTANT FEEDBACK
items.value: Receive real-time feedback to instantly improve your shooting performance.

items.label: IMPROVE SHOT ACCURACY
items.value: With over 10 million shots tracked, our system has been shown to improve shooting accuracy by 15% or more with consistent use.

items.label: COMPREHENSIVE APP
items.value: Track, measure, and record your shooting performance. Enjoy gamification features to compete with TF-DNA community members globally, participate in weekly challenges to earn badges, and access tips and lessons from top trainers across the country.

items.label: COST-EFFECTIVE TRAINING
items.value: At approximately $3 per week, it's a more affordable alternative to a personal skills or shooting coach.

items.label: IDEAL GIFT FOR ALL
items.value: Ideal for players of all ages and skill levels, from beginners to seasoned pros. Available in both men's (29.5) and women’s/youth (28.5) official sizes and weights.

items.label: EXTENSIVE USAGE TIME
items.value: Benefit from up to 500 hours of tracking, analytics, and shot coaching.

items: Compatible with both Apple iOS & Android devices.
